picks.name: OnlyJeans
picks.reason: Exceptionally clean distribution (top10 4.3%, 2796 holders, 0% creator/insider, 100% LP locked) with broad buying (0.71 buy ratio, 7.8x turnover) and liquidity at 16% of a still-small $347k mcap. picks.name: Nuvex
picks.reason: Steady broad-based climb (not a vertical spike) with 61% buy ratio, liquidity at a strong 34% of its tiny $61k mcap, low top-10 concentration, and real socials — an hour old with plenty of room to run. picks.name: Cat on Board
picks.reason: Rare distribution profile for a 1h-old coin (top10 holders 1.3%, 3,817 holders, zero creator stake, LP 100% locked) with a healthy 0.68 buy ratio and mcap still small at $252k vs $45k liquidity. Main risk: 30 paid DexScreener boosts and a sharp -14% pullback in the last 5min after the +70% 1h spike, so it may already be cooling off.

picks.name: Uptober
picks.reason: Uptober is riding a genuine seasonal crypto narrative with broad organic support: 3,458 holders, 0.82 buy ratio, only 17.7% top-10 concentration, 100% LP locked, and liquidity at 16.6% of a modest $319k mcap. Main risk: it's carrying a full paid DexScreener boost and 1h momentum has gone slightly negative, so some of the attention is manufactured and the initial push may be cooling.

picks.name: That's AI

Main risk: 1h price is down 14% and buy ratio is soft (0.53), so momentum may be cooling right as we'd enter.

picks.name: PIPEJEAN
picks.reason: Excellent distribution (top10 3.5%, 5,559 holders, LP locked, zero insider/creator holdings) with broad organic buying (9,525 buyers/6h, 0.86 buy ratio, 9x turnover) and healthy liquidity at 17% of a still-small $262k mcap. Main risk: already up 233% in its first hour with a -6.8% 5-min pullback, so a chunk of the easy move may be behind it — treat as a momentum continuation bet, not an entry near the bottom.

picks.name: Uptober
